serving_backup_projection.new: deep-copy the current policy state and apply the same per-chunk HBM/DRAM admissions; gate on the projected HBM bytes actually retained

slack_prediction.new: independent categorical output prediction and independent residual from a seed-separated stream

copy_paths.reason: source-owned Peer-HBM and direct DRAM use separate serialized per-tier lanes; request copy critical path is max of admitted tier service, never the sum
copy_paths.byte_rule: each admitted tier is charged exactly chunk_tokens times kv_bytes_per_token

primary_estimands.healthy_wct: mean no-fault workflow completion time over the common workflow universe
primary_estimands.same_probe_failure_conditioned_wct: for each shared probe, mean replay WCT over every workflow in that same universe, then equal-weight across probes
primary_estimands.all_workflow_total_wct: healthy_wct plus all-workflow added-WCT; audited to equal same-probe fault replay WCT
primary_estimands.primary_denominator: workflow_count times fault_probe_count; never the policy-specific changed subset

secondary_diagnostic: changed-only metrics remain within-policy diagnostics and are forbidden as primary cross-policy evidence
evidence_boundary: Preliminary metadata DES correction rerun, not a physical result and not paper-ready. Native Mooncake remains a modeled approximation. The independent Slack predictor is an uncalibrated causal approximation, and 500 ms/60 s remain modeled and unmeasured.
